t: Similar Stocks
s: Two stocks being practically identical means that when you look at the daily movement of the stocks, along with the return profiles going back 1, 2 and 5 years, the stocks have pratically identical movements and return profiles. A simple example of this would be the Schwab ETF SCHB and the Vanguard fund VTI, which both attempt to index the same underlying groups of stocks and thus have very similar movements and returns.

t: Similar Stocks by Wei He, Huaixin Wang, Yuehan Wang, Jianfeng Yu :: SSRN
s: April 1, 2021 - The long-short portfolio strategy sorted on similar stocks' past average return earns a monthly CAPM alpha of 1.44% and a Fama-French five-factor alpha of 1.39%. This similarity effect is robust after controlling for style investing, factor momentum, and a wide range of well-known firm-level characteristics that can predict returns in the cross-section. Our result is consistent with the increased propensity for investors to buy other stocks with similar characteristics after experiencing positive returns for a currently held stock.
